early_close_rule.rule: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-10-25 before any audit number was read: a selectable strategy must close early (agent closes > 0 on the calibration block), otherwise DEGENERATE_NO_EARLY_CLOSE and not selectable (owner's business rule); the early-close value is a REQUIRED reported metric for every arm; a closer whose early-close value 95 % CI is entirely < 0 is HARMFUL_EARLY_CLOSE (it cuts winners): a defect to fix, not a reason to remove early closing
early_close_rule.selection: owner 2026-10-25 (pre-registered before any audit number was read): early close is indispensable; with strategy.require_early_close a point that never closes voluntarily on the calibration block (agent closes = 0) is DEGENERATE_NO_EARLY_CLOSE and not selectable; it stays in the archive
early_close_rule.required_metric: early-close value = sum over agent closes of (actual net - engine counterfactual hold net), USD and sigma, bootstrap 95 % CI over trades; reported for every arm (tools/expert_guided_early_close_audit.py)

flags.HARMFUL_EARLY_CLOSE: early-close value 95 % CI entirely < 0: the closer cuts winners; a defect to fix, never a reason to remove early closing
